content_sections.heading: GEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria: Post-Wise Qualification, Age & Experience
content_sections.text: Educational qualification, age limit, and experience requirements vary by post. Only full-time regular qualifications are considered valid unless stated otherwise in the official notification. Qualification: Graduate with full-time MBA / MHRM / MSW / MLW or equivalent postgraduate degree in HR, Personnel Management, or Organisation Development; certification in OD, Talent Management, or Change Management preferred. Age Limit: 38 to 45 years Experience: Minimum 15 years post-qualification, including at least 5 years leading enterprise-wide HR strategy Qualification: Full-time Bachelor's / Diploma in any Engineering discipline Age Limit: 30 to 45 years Experience: Minimum 5 years in Oil & Gas / E&P operations, with at least 3 years managing an oil collecting station Qualification: Degree or Diploma in Fire & Safety Engineering; faq.question: Q1. What is Gujarat Energy Limited (GEL)?
faq.answer: Gujarat Energy Limited (GEL) is the company formerly known as Gujarat Gas Limited, engaged in Exploration & Production, Gas Trading, City Gas Distribution, and Renewable Energy Generation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for GEL Recruitment 2026 is 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Are GEL Recruitment 2026 posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: All 11 posts advertised under GEL Recruitment 2026 are on a contract basis.

faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official GEL careers portal at gujarat-energy.com/careers/current-openings by selecting the relevant job code and submitting the application form with required documents.
